panels.title: Unique Sessions
panels.description: Distinct Faro sessions seen in the selected range

panels.title: Swaps Completed
panels.description: Solver redeemed on destination — funnel end

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_completed" | logfmt | event_name="swap_completed" [$__range])) / (sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=user_lock_confirmed" | logfmt | event_name="user_lock_confirmed" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Median Time to Complete

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_completed" | logfmt | event_name="swap_completed" | unwrap event_data_elapsed_ms | __error__="" [$__range])

panels.description: From swap creation to solver redeem (p50)

panels.title: Funnel — unique sessions reaching each stage

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=session_start" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=route_selected" | logfmt | event_name="route_selected" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=quote_received" | logfmt | event_name="quote_received" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=destination_address_set" | logfmt | event_name="destination_address_set" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_form_submitted" | logfmt | event_name="swap_form_submitted" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=user_lock_clicked" | logfmt | event_name="user_lock_clicked" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=user_lock_confirmed" | logfmt | event_name="user_lock_confirmed" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=solver_lock_detected" | logfmt | event_name="solver_lock_detected" [$__range]))) or vector(0)
count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_completed" | logfmt | event_name="swap_completed" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Each bar counts distinct sessions that emitted the stage event. The step where the count collapses is where users drop off.

panels.title: Why users can't proceed (CTA states)
panels.description: Distribution of blocking CTA states shown on the swap form (cta_state_shown). 'ready' means nothing blocked the user.

panels.title: Quote failures by reason
panels.description: limit_min / limit_max = amount outside solver limits; no_quote = no solver quoted; request_error = API failure

panels.title: User lock failures by reason
panels.description: user_rejected = wallet prompt declined; quote_expired; insufficient_funds; transaction_failed = reverted on-chain

panels.title: Verification & trust outcomes

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=verification_passed" | logfmt | event_name="verification_passed" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=verification_failed" | logfmt | event_name="verification_failed" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=verification_mismatch" | logfmt | event_name="verification_mismatch" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=verification_skipped" | logfmt | event_name="verification_skipped" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=identity_mismatch_warning" | logfmt | event_name="identity_mismatch_warning" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Solver-lock verification results. Failures and mismatches block auto-reveal — direct drop-off causes.

panels.title: Abandonment: modal closed mid-swap

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_htlc_status) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_modal_closed" | logfmt | event_name="swap_modal_closed" | event_data_was_terminal="false" [$__interval]))

panels.description: swap_modal_closed with was_terminal=false, split by the HTLC status at close time — at which phase users walk away

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (event_data_source_network, event_data_destination_network) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=swap_form_submitted" | logfmt | event_name="swap_form_submitted" [$__range])))

panels.title: Exceptions over time by type
panels.description: context_train_exception_type set by app captureException calls; empty = uncaught/console errors

targets.expr: {app=~"$app", kind="exception"} | logfmt | session_id=~"$session.*" | line_format "{{.value}} | type={{.context_train_exception_type}} | page={{.page_url}} | session={{.session_id}}"

count by (event_data_provider) (count by (event_data_provider, session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=wallet_connected" | logfmt | event_name="wallet_connected" [$__range])))

panels.title: Login outcomes

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=login_started" | logfmt | event_name="login_started" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=login_succeeded" | logfmt | event_name="login_succeeded" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=login_failed" | logfmt | event_name="login_failed" [$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", kind="event"} |= "event_name=login_unsupported_browser" | logfmt | event_name="login_unsupported_browser" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Passkey login funnel — the gate before any swap can be submitted

panels.title: Swap timeline — set $hashlock to trace one swap

targets.expr: {app=~"$app"} | logfmt | event_data_hashlock=~"$hashlock.*" or context_hashlock=~"$hashlock.*" | kind=~"event|exception" | line_format "[{{.kind}}] {{.event_name}}{{.value}} status={{.event_data_htlc_status}} session={{.session_id}}"

{app=~"$app"} | logfmt | session_id=~"$session.*" | kind=~"event|exception|log" | event_name!~"faro\..*" | line_format "[{{.kind}}] {{.event_name}}{{.message}}{{.value}} view={{.view_name}} url={{.page_url}}"
